hero.headline: AGRICULTURAL NDVI MAPPING
hero.title: Transforming Agriculture with Aerial Intelligence
hero.description:
At SmartGrid Surveying, we empower modern agriculture with cutting-edge drone solutions designed to maximize yields, reduce costs, and make data-driven farming a reality. 

 Our drone technology brings real-time insights from above—helping farmers monitor crops, optimize inputs, and make informed decisions across their agricultural operations.

 Smartgrid Surveying is your trusted surveying partner!

whyUseDronesInAgriculture.headline: Why Use Drones in Agriculture?
whyUseDronesInAgriculture.description: Our drone technology brings real-time insights from above—helping farmers monitor crops, optimize inputs, and make informed decisions across their agricultural operations.

items.title: Save Time & Labor
items.description: Cover large areas in minutes compared to manual fieldwork.

items.title: Improve Resource Efficiency
items.description: Apply inputs only where needed, reducing cost and environmental impact.

items.title: Make Smarter Decisions
items.description: Use aerial data for real-time field assessments and historical trend analysis.

items.title: Enhance Sustainability
items.description: Promote conservation agriculture through better land and input management.

items.title: Needs Assessment & Site Planning
items.description: We begin by understanding the specific agricultural goals—whether it’s crop health, irrigation analysis, or yield estimation—and plan the flight accordingly.

items.title: Drone Deployment
items.description: Using multispectral or RGB drones, we conduct automated flights capturing aerial data with GPS precision, ensuring full field coverage.

items.title: Data Capture
items.description: Collect NDVI, RGB, thermal, or LiDAR data depending on the survey needs. High-resolution geotagged imagery is recorded in real-time.

items.title: Data Processing & Mapping
items.description: The imagery is stitched into orthomosaics and analyzed to generate crop health maps, topographic contours, and vegetation indices.

items.title: Report Generation & Insights
items.description: We compile actionable insights—highlighting issues such as underperforming zones or stress areas—for improved farming decisions.

items.title: Delivery & Support
items.description: Final maps and data are delivered in GIS-ready formats with expert interpretation support and integration guidance.
